event_data.continuation_prompt:
CONTINUATION MISSION: Verify and polish the mobile dashboard improvements from Cycle 1.

In Cycle 1, four mobile dashboard issues were addressed in these files:
- dashboard_templates/main_bundled.html
- dashboard_static/css/main.css  
- dashboard_static/src/main.js

Changes made:
1. Header row 2 scrollable on mobile (overflow-x: auto)
2. overscroll-behavior-x: contain on .mobile-scroll-wrapper
3. Numbered column nav buttons (1 Controls, 2 Analytics, 3 Activity) replacing old dots
4. AtlasLab service status completely removed

For Cycle 2, perform a thorough visual review using screenshots on mobile viewport to confirm:
1. The numbered navigation buttons look polished and are easy to tap (check sizing, spacing, contrast)
2. The header Lock/Unlock button is actually reachable by scrolling the header row on a phone-sized screen
3. Column switching via the nav buttons works smoothly with no visual glitches
4. No orphaned AtlasLab references remain anywhere in the codebase (search all files, not just the 3 modified)
5. The investigation status display looks correct after the HTML restructuring
6. Test on both 375px (standard phone) and 320px (small phone) viewports

If any visual or functional issues are found, fix them. Write a final summary report to artifacts/final_report.md.

cycle_report.summary: Addressed all 4 mobile dashboard UX issues: made the header toolbar scrollable so Lock/Unlock buttons are accessible on mobile, added overscroll-behavior-x:contain to prevent accidental browser back/forward navigation when swiping between columns, replaced the legacy non-functional dot indicators with numbered column navigation buttons (1 Controls, 2 Analytics, 3 Activity), and removed the AtlasLab service status that shouldn't be in the public release dashboard. All changes were verified with 23 Selenium tests (11 functional + 12 adversarial) on mobile viewports including 320px tiny phones.
achievements: Header row 2 (.header-row-2) made horizontally scrollable on mobile with overflow-x:auto so Lock/Unlock buttons are accessible
Added overscroll-behavior-x:contain to .mobile-scroll-wrapper to prevent accidental browser back/forward gestures when swiping between columns
Replaced legacy scroll-dot indicators with labeled column-nav-btn buttons showing '1 Controls', '2 Analytics', '3 Activity' for easy column switching
Removed AtlasLab service status HTML element, JS polling endpoint, and updateAtlasLabServiceStatus function from dashboard
Fixed investigation-service-status HTML nesting bug caused by AtlasLab removal
All 23 tests passed including adversarial edge cases (rapid switching, invalid indices, tiny viewports, resize cycles)
Bundle CSS and JS rebuilt with all changes
issues: None - all 4 requirements met cleanly with no regressions
